argv: Map layers and walkability by urban form (specs/map-layers, specs/walkability-urban-form, decisions 0096, 0097)
ops.body: - The Layers panel is translucent (the area title and search show through its first rows) and a switch's on track is pale against the panel (places-layer UX review U3, U4, Nov 19): both are the panel's and `SwitchRow`'s own, there before the Places layer. A solid panel surface and a track at 3:1 would fix both; screenshots are the check.
